# Hormiga

Hormiga is a personal finance manager for households sharing money across
multiple currencies. Teams keep accounts, cards and cash in one shared
ledger, log income and expense transactions with tags, and see balances
per currency, including fiat and bitcoin, without converting everything
into a single blended number. Currency and crypto exchange rates sync
automatically. Free plan available, no card required; Pro removes the
free plan's account, member and transaction limits.

- Homepage (English): http://127.0.0.1:8000/en
- Homepage (Spanish): http://127.0.0.1:8000/es
- Sign up / log in: http://127.0.0.1:8000/login
